title: A Limiting Satisfiability Threshold for Every Fixed Clause Size

abstractEnglish: For every fixed integer k ≥ 3, random k-SAT with independent uniformly signed clauses on distinct variables, sampled with replacement, has a finite positive limiting satisfiability threshold. We credit Gaia Carenini [[5]](https://eccc.weizmann.ac.il/report/2026/229/) with priority for resolving the satisfiability conjecture. This paper gives an alternative proof, using concentration of a capped last satisfiable index and a comparison between different system sizes.
